title: Rock & Roll
lyrics:
[Verse]
Snow is falling thick and bright
Reindeer footprints in the night
Cookies vanish
Milk is gone
Who's that laughing till the dawn

[Prechorus]
Chimneys whisper
Magic flows
Candy canes in secret rows

[Chorus]
Christmas time with Santa Claus
Sliding rooftops
No time to pause
Ho ho ho
He’s on his way
Bringing joy to Christmas Day

[Verse 2]
Stockings hang by the fire’s glow
Toys and dreams in a sack to go
Elves are dancing
Wrapping fast
Every wish will make it past

[Prechorus]
Midnight sparkles
Sleigh bells sing
Feel the joy that he will bring

[Chorus]
Christmas time with Santa Claus
Sliding rooftops
No time to pause
Ho ho ho
He’s on his way
Bringing joy to Christmas Day
